text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
NameAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(y) ::: y is a settlement.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
SouthwestCoast(x) ::: x is on the southwest coast.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
Include(y, z) ::: y includes z.
LocatedInTransitive(x, y) ::: if x is in y and y is in z, then x is in z.
Country(x, y) ::: x is part of country y.
BulgarianSettlement(y) ::: y is a Bulgarian settlement.
SnowIsland(x) ::: x is Snow Island.
GreenwichIsland(x) ::: x is Greenwich Island.
DeceptionIsland(x) ::: x is Deception Island.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is part of Antarctica.
Premises:
Barutin(x) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ Settlement(y) ::: Barutin is named after a settlement y.
BarutinCove(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ SouthwestCoast(y) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SnowIsland(x) ∧ PartOf(x, Antarctica) ::: Snow Island is part of Antarctica.
GreenwichIsland(x) ∧ PartOf(x, Antarctica) ::: Greenwich Island is part of Antarctica.
DeceptionIsland(x) ∧ PartOf(x, Antarctica) ::: Deception Island is part of Antarctica.
If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C ::: ∀A ∀B ∀C (LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C) → LocatedIn(A, C))
Including Snow Island, Greenwich Island, Deception Island in Antarctica ::: Include(SnowIsland, Antarctica) ∧ Include(GreenwichIsland, Antarctica) ∧ Include(DeceptionIsland, Antarctica)
Conclusion:
∃x (Cove(x) ∧ NameAfter(x, y) ∧ Settlement(y) ∧ PartOf(y, Bulgaria) ∧ PartOf(x, Antarctica))
